title: Discover Structure Without Labels
core_invariant: Clustering is an engineering investigation, not a way to manufacture classes. Declare a feature and distance contract before fitting. Unscaled K-means can look persuasive while following a high-magnitude instrumentation feature. Internal diagnostics (inertia, silhouette, stability, sizes) are not a truth oracle. Cluster identifiers are nominal. These clusters are not true classes without external validation. Predict before running. Transfer without assistance. Prove competence with evidence.

stages.title: Frame unlabelled structure as a useful whole
stages.instructions: Read the M14 invariant and datasets/M14/learning_sessions.csv. Exclude identifiers such as session_id from the feature set. The high-magnitude activity_events column is a teaching trap for unscaled Euclidean K-means. The working loop is unlabelled observations → feature contract → scaling → candidate k → internal diagnostics → cluster profiles → cautious interpretation. Identify gate evidence: feature contract, candidate-k table, center profiles, controlled-failure diagnosis, ADR, and no-AI transfer on a different unlabelled dataset. No custom M14 frontend. Target labels are not available to this lab.

stages.title: Predict the raw-scale trap, then compare candidate k
stages.instructions: Complete the experiment cycle. (1) PREDICT which feature contributes most to squared Euclidean distance on raw values and which k in 2 through 6 will balance separation, stability, and useful sizes after standardization. (2) COMMIT the prediction. (3) EXECUTE raw k=3, then standardize the declared features and fit candidates with fixed seeds. (4) OBSERVE feature-level distance contributions, inertia, mean silhouette, minimum cluster size, and assignment stability. (5) SUBMIT an explanation why an internally separated raw partition can still be a unit-and-scale artifact, and defend k with converging evidence rather than maximum silhouette. Return a table of candidate-k diagnostics plus a metric of the dominant raw-distance feature.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Prediction is sealed before execute; raw-scale dominance is quantified; k is not declared from a single diagnostic.

stages.title: Trace a candidate-k diagnostic
stages.instructions: Read evaluate_candidate before running it. For k=3: which matrix defines the geometry, which state fit_predict learns, why n_init=20 and a fixed random_state, why inertia is not 'larger is better', what mean silhouette hides, why adjusted Rand is permutation-invariant, and which line fails if k=1. Sketch CSV → selected features → scaler state → standardized matrix → centers/assignments → internal diagnostics → interpretation and mark every consequential choice.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Trace marks scaler state, assignment storage, and why k=1 is excluded.

stages.title: Diagnose the persuasive segmentation
stages.instructions: Reject the claim 'K-means found the three real learner types' because the plot has clean colors, silhouette is positive, and a stakeholder asked for three segments. Diagnose four traps: (1) scale — which feature supplies most of the squared-distance budget on raw values; (2) arbitrary k — compare requested k=3 with k=2..6 including small-cluster fragmentation; (3) outlier — inject one extreme instrumentation value and compare assignments for unchanged rows; (4) visualization — a two-component PCA view is not proof of natural classes. Quantify comparisons.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Diagnoses scale, arbitrary k, outlier, and projection traps with quantified comparisons.

stages.title: Cluster a fresh unlabelled table without assistance
stages.instructions: Without AI-generated code or the M14 fixture, select three to seven defensible features on a fresh unlabelled numeric dataset, predict the dominant raw-distance feature, compare at least four candidate k values after justified preprocessing, record evidence against the chosen k, show original-unit center profiles, stress with an outlier or unit conversion, and write one paragraph beginning 'These clusters are not true classes because …'.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Uses a different unlabelled dataset and does not claim true classes without external validation.

stages.title: Record feature, scaling, algorithm, and k decisions
stages.instructions: Write an ADR covering included features, excluded identifiers, scaling, algorithm, and k. Include context, alternatives, consequences, and reversal triggers. Learner-authored ADRs stay outside this package.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: ADR records feature contract, scaling, k, alternatives, and reversal triggers.

stages.title: Integrate clustering diagnostics into V03
stages.instructions: M14 extends V03 beyond supervised comparison. Expose cluster assignments and diagnostics as analytical outputs, not as stable identities, risk tiers, or true classes. Any downstream action requires a separately reviewed purpose and external validation.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: States that V03 must not treat cluster ids as true classes or risk tiers.

stages.title: Evaluate unsupervised-structure evidence
stages.instructions: Evaluate feature contract, scale/k experiment, controlled-failure diagnosis, no-AI transfer, and ADR. Issue PASSED or targeted repair. A colorful cluster plot by itself does not pass.
